perItemFindings.one_line: Delivered tier subfield < floor field; not salvageable within scope.

verbatim_critique: [D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The delivered results identify finite-horizon cohort counterfactual laws and ATT only under known finite order, exact time homogeneity, predictive rank, invertible killed dynamics, and the substantive hazard-in-emission-algebra restriction; they do not establish identification throughout the aliased stopped-HMM class. The generic converse, exact 2/185 fiber, and collision modulus substantiate failure outside that restriction, but the complete K=3 one-alias-block boundary classification remains open. The named Kim--Lee use case is only a proposed consumer: no stratum is shown to pass the rank, HDK, conditioning, support, gray-zone, and precision gates, so practical usability is unestablished. The framing accurately discloses both omissions, but they constrain the leading-journal score because the paper currently supplies neither the promised complete frontier diagnostic nor reproducible evidence that its demanding regular regime occurs in the motivating panel. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 7.2 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
